name: Frustration
overview: Scripture reveals that frustration often arises from circumstances beyond our control, but God invites believers to trust Him fully rather than rely on their own understanding, promising to direct their paths and fight on their behalf. The Lord draws near to those with broken and contrite hearts, offering comfort and strength, encouraging His people to be still and trust in His sustaining power. In moments of fear and discouragement, God assures His presence and help, enabling believers to overcome frustration through faith and reliance on His righteousness.
